quizGuardRationale: Author judgments for independent assessment, not review findings: use direct ordinary meanings and actual labels; exclusions are symmetric and nontransitive. No baseline declaration is changed and no nonexistent target is used.
持参 guards 持つ/運ぶ carrying meanings; the bring/take contextual distinction remains explicit. 磁石 and 四捨五入 have no established existing direct-answer counterpart in the inspected set.

始終 guards directly applicable always/continually/frequently labels on 常に/いつも/年中/ずっと/しきりに/しばしば/たびたび/よく/再三/くれぐれも/ちょこちょこ, and continuation or repetition labels on 継続/続く/続ける/繰り返す/重ねる. Frequency use is positively sourced, not inferred from the characters. Continued action and repeated occasions are assessed separately; no automatic inheritance from another frequency card. 続き's remaining part is not the whole start-to-end span.

自習 guards direct study/learning/practice labels on 勉強/学習/学ぶ/学/学問/練習/稽古. 実習 separately guards direct practice/training/learning labels on 練習/訓練/稽古/研修/学習/勉強/学ぶ/習う/学/学問. Self-directed and practical learning are different axes; merely being able to do both does not make 自習 and 実習 equivalent answers.

静まる guards actual quiet/calm/silence meanings on 静か/落ち着く/しーん/穏やか/冷静/黙る/おとなしい/しっとり, settling-disturbance uses on 治める/収める and stopping on 止まる. Change/state and transitivity distinctions are taught rather than used as an automatic escape from English-label ambiguity. そっと action manner and しんみり reflective sentiment are not automatically quiet-down answers.
姿勢 guards posture/attitude/position/bearing meanings on 態度/格好/立場/位置/形/姿/様子/気持ち. 模様's patterns or situational appearance do not automatically become bodily bearing or a stance toward action.
自然科学 guards 科学, not every member discipline or all scholarship. 時速 guards 速度, not every time/distance noun.

子孫 guards 子/子供 offspring meanings; 孫 specifies a grandchild rather than generic descendants. 死体 guards actual body labels on 体/身体/身 without importing unrelated むくろ or other-reading corpse families into their article identities.

下書き guards 原稿/案 draft or prepared-text labels and the unqualified copy/write labels on コピー/写す/書く. This is an English-answer ambiguity precaution, not permission to replace drafting with photocopying in Japanese. 書き取り's dictation is not a direct rough-draft counterpart.
下町 guards 町/地区/区域 district labels, without treating every city or region as a lower-city district. 自治 guards 独立's independence label; 管理/政治/自由 do not form an automatic governance/freedom clique.

実感 guards direct feeling/feeling-as-experience/impression labels on 感じ/感じる/感ずる/感覚/気持ち/気分/気味/感情/経験/味わう/思う/感想. Their ordinary senses are individually inspected, not inferred from emotional themes. 気's spirit/mood and 印象's remembered impression are not automatically a felt realization.
湿気 guards 湿度's humidity label and actual damp/moist/humid meanings on じめじめ/じとじと/しっとり/蒸す. Heat, measurement and pleasantness differences are qualified rather than absolute nonoverlap rules.

しつこい guards persistence/excessive-richness meanings on くどい/こってり/しきりに/飽くまで/濃い/べたべた/継続 and the actual heavy labels on 重い/重たい. This does not make physical weight the Japanese food meaning. 脂/油 are substances, not automatically the adjective greasy.

実績 guards direct actual-performance/result/achievement labels on 成績/功績/結果/効果/成功/記録/収穫/働き. Their secondary performance or fruitful-result senses are included. 実/み's fruit and whole expression 実を結ぶ do not license pooling the unrelated 実/じつ good-result sense into that article.
sourceAccessLimits: Nineteen new articles cover twenty source rows, N2:662-N2:681; no reused article. Named community-list membership is not an official modern JLPT syllabus.
Five newly tracked primary N2 reciprocal pairs: 捨/四捨五入, 勢/姿勢, 孫/子孫, 湿/湿気 and 績/実績. All existing component reading rows and source-only qualifications are preserved.
Missing primary 磁/姿 remain in word metadata or plain text, not fabricated kanji/stroke cards. Kana-primary しつこい has no manufactured primary components.
One 湿気 article explicitly teaches primary しっけ and alternate しっき while preserving both original source rows. No unsupported reading-frequency ranking.
